chose: A read is aligned to its script word by word (Levenshtein over composed, lowercased words without punctuation or apostrophes; a filler reads only the same filler in the script and is otherwise an inserted word, and a filler on either side never substitutes for another word); an added word is repeated when the same word was spoken within 3 words of it, by a word that reads the script or an earlier added one; a pause is at a break when the script has punctuation, a spaced dash or a line end (but not a lone full stop, comma or colon between two all-digit words, as in 10:30) anywhere from the last word read before it to the next word read after it, or when nothing has been read yet; pace variation is the standard deviation over the mean of the words a minute of each phrase between breaks with at least 3 words, timed first word to last.
options: (a) word alignment, a repeat within 3 words, variation as the coefficient of variation over phrases of 3 or more words
(b) a repeat only when it follows the same word directly
(c) variation over fixed windows of time rather than the script's phrases
gray: #2934 names the measures (misreads, pauses at breaks against mid-phrase, pace variation) and leaves their rules open; each rule decides what the owner sees counted as a stumble or a stiff read.
undo: Change REPEAT_WINDOW or MIN_PHRASE_WORDS in packages/ui/interview-week/src/lib/faults/thresholds.ts, or readCost, isRepeat, breaksAfter, phrasePaces and variation in read.ts.
